one_liner: Deal and relationship management platform for financial services.
access_notes: Credentials are provisioned inside a customer tenant by an admin; user enables and copies API key, and some features require account manager enablement.
blocker_notes: Customers must provision credentials in-tenant; some eventing requires account manager enablement; moderate rate limits and short-lived tokens.

evidence.quote: DealCloud uses the OAuth2 Client Credentials flow to generate a bearer token… Tokens expire after 900 seconds (15 minutes) and must be refreshed by repeating the flow.
Scroll down to the API Key section and click Enable. Then click Copy API Key to Clipboard to copy your API key…
Each DealCloud site provides an interactive Swagger page… Postman can consume the Swagger/OpenAPI spec file exposed at ‘https://{host}/swagger/current’
Get in touch with your account manager to have Publications enabled on your site.
This includes a non-production (or preview) sandbox that allows you to safely test new features, configurations, APIs…

_trail.quote: "DealCloud provides a default MCP Server out-of-the-box without any configuration required."
